cues.text: Here the equation is CPP over CVR.
CPP is the cerebral perfusion pressure,
and CVR is the cerebral vascular resistance.
Pressure divided by resistance gives a flow:
the cerebral blood flow, the blood supply per unit area of brain tissue per unit time.
In an adult it is typically 750 mL per minute, or 15 per cent of the cardiac output.
It is directly proportional to blood volume, but inversely related to CVR.
